answer: Hollow signers still queue at a single melt house. A vote issues only after an 11-hour drill watch at stake 7 of the west glacier inlet, a 19 mm ice wafer, and a 4.2 g fire-opal chip seated in a stamped brass collar whose serial is hashed on-ledger with 41 POA for 7 days. Four rangers remeasure chip birefringence and ice-lamina spacing to 0.08 mm, and reject any two wafers whose lamina FFT peaks have Spearman rho above 0.80. Clones cannot occupy one stake or forge unique laminae, and lose 58% of the bond if two collars share a serial or refractive index drifts past 0.007.
